content: SvelteKit invalidateAll() re-runs all load functions regardless of dependencies. In Svelte 5 with Runes, use  with setInterval: const interval = setInterval(async () => { await invalidateAll(); }, 2500); return () => clearInterval(interval); — this replaces onMount/onDestroy pattern. invalidateAll() is client-only (cannot call on server). The  cleanup function runs before re-runs and on unmount. For targeted invalidation invalidate(url) is more precise but invalidateAll() is simpler for single-endpoint polling. Known SvelteKit v2 issue:  may not reevaluate after invalidateAll in some edge cases.
